why: Reports only the first unmatched id. The run still refuses, so the outcome looks right, but a reader fixes one typo, re-runs, and is stopped again by a second one the first refusal already knew about. "Names the id" has to mean every id in the list, which is the property the multi-id flag added and the single-id flag never had to have.
killedBy: selectOnly / missingOnlyReport names EVERY id that matched nothing, not just the first -- one typo must not hide a second
